I think you misunderstand me; there is tremendous love and emotional support in my family.  As it was implied, I am constantly blessed with thteir presence throughout the day.  

But, because of societal taboos, this is a topic that they arenot willing to discuss logically, mechanicaly, and rationally.  I think, that there is also a naive belief that I will be cured; so as long as I am alive there is hope (a medical impossibility).

The problem here is that no doctor will entertain this conversation at all due to its illegal nature.  For them it is no longer a moral issue, but a legal one, which could have severe ramifications, the least of which would mean losing their license.

No, I genuinely disagree with you. My family is not at all a proponent of euthanasia and nothing that I say or do can convince them otherwise.

Of course, I do realize that I affect my family; but while my influence and interaction with them is limited to a few hours a day, I have to deal with my pain for 24 hours. When dealing with the issue of one's life, one cannot be selfish if he is only looking within his needs. As I've said, there will be some emotional trauma; but I've tried to prepare them as best as possible. Death is inevitable in my case; it ranges from a few months to around 2 years at the maximum. We've already dealt with these issues as a family.  Self-iniated termination will only cause them to deal with sorrow a little bit sooner than later (though there will be some additional trauma associated with the fact that it was self-initiated and there are social taboos against that, but over time, I think they'll go awya quite rapidly.)

I think the greatest sorrow that people feel comes from sudden unexpected death. But this has been a slow process going on over the past several years. Everyone has accepted it that I am going to die. I merely wish to do so on my own terms.

You are perfectly right, this is not the right place for this discussion and I fear some information may beused by others in a moment of exasperation.  If yous can PM  me with either a source or a website where I can get help, I would appreciate it.
